title: What 'Called to More' Actually Means for the Job You Hate Right Now
caption:
You're not on pause until the real calling shows up. This job, the one you're tempted to phone in, is already the assignment.

Whoever can be trusted with little can be trusted with much. Do the boring part like someone's watching, because someone is.

Take the job in front of you seriously today. That's how the next one opens.

#faith #work #christianmen #discipline #manofgod
